name: Fu Wang
source:
The oldest prisoner, it's a wonder how he hasn't lost the talent yet given how past his prime he is. Once every product and brand were flooding to Fu to try to get him to boost their sales or even just endorse their product, now companies are slowly distancing themselves from him. He's still an incredibly talented Salesman, just a bit... Burnt out.

He seems more focused on finding a secure alcohol supply than finding a way out or collaborating with the other prisoners, unless they're interested in gambling with him. Most prisoners tend to avoid him due to his 'jokes' which end up just sounding like he's mocking them. He seems oddly calm in the prison compared to the other prisoners.

When we interrogated him about his crime he chuckled and asked if the government sent us. For that reason we should monitor him closely, he could know something he shouldn't.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Fu_Wang]Wiki[/url]]
